A well-dressed man is framed from mid-torso to head, centered in the composition. His head is slightly raised with a calm, composed expression and a confident upward gaze. When a reference image is provided, the face, hairstyle, skin texture, and overall identity must closely match the reference, preserving natural proportions and realism without stylization or alteration. Shadows remain deep but smooth with gradual tonal transitions.

A subtle layer of atmospheric fog or smoke sits mainly in the lower frame, catching blue light and adding depth without obscuring the subject.
Framing & Composition

Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Medium portrait framing. The subject remains fully inside the frame with safe margins on both sides so shoulders and arms are not cropped. Maintain comfortable headroom above the hair. The neon circle remains fully visible and perfectly centered to reinforce symmetry and balance.
